title: Archive through September 28, 2003 - Anonymous (Tuesday, September 16, 2003 - 08:55 pm)
content: After having a routine colonoscopy, I experienced moderate left shoulder pain. I was told to go home and rest. My husband became alarmed later as I was having trouble breathing and took me to the ER. After a work up it was discovered I had a ruptured spleen and significant blood lost and was rushed to the operating room. I knew people were talking right in front of me but they sounded far away. The next thing I knew the pain was gone and I was standing on a very narrow ledge. I had the feeling that there was darkness and a void behind me. I had on a long robe and my arms were out stretched as if I was going to fly. I had the most peaceful feeling and I was overjoyed that the pain was gone. Wind blew my hair and I felt so cool and relaxed. In front of me was a beautiful lake, the color of green/blue was overwhelming. On the surface at the horizon was a bright silver sphere with triangles projecting. It reminded me of the sunrise. From the sphere a bright silver ribbon flowed to the water's edge. I looked down and the water was just gently lapping toward my toes, my feet were bare. I tried very hard to move forward but I was glued to the spot, I just knew if I could get to the water I would be lifted up on the water and float to the sphere. But try I as I may I could not move my feet. The next thing I know is I wake up and I am in the ICU unit, having lost close to 6 pints of blood.

environment.environment_other_detail: A very narrow ledge with a dark void behind; a beautiful green/blue lake; at the horizon a bright silver sphere with triangles projecting; a bright silver ribbon flowing from the sphere to the water's edge; water gently lapping at her toes.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Ruptured spleen after a routine colonoscopy; rushed to the operating room with significant blood loss.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: She heard people talking far away; pain disappeared; found herself standing on a narrow ledge with a void behind; could not move forward toward the water/sphere; then woke in ICU.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No tunnel or beings; transition from hearing distant voices to an otherworldly environment on a ledge by a lake; then abrupt return/waking in ICU.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Bright silver sphere with triangles projecting at the horizon; a bright silver ribbon flowing from the sphere to the water's edge; inability to move as if 'glued to the spot' while trying to reach the water to float toward the sphere.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “The next thing I knew the pain was gone and I was standing on a very narrow ledge.” “I had the feeling that there was darkness and a void behind me.” “I tried very hard to move forward but I was glued to the spot.”
